name: legacy-code-transformation-demo
description: A bounded proof of concept for source-grounded, approval-gated refactoring proposals.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/workspace-scope.js && node --check src/workspace-discovery.js && node --check src/source-evidence.js && node --check src/roslyn-worker.js && node --check src/proposal-contract.js && node --check src/foundry-adapter.js && node --check src/proposal-report.js && node --check src/proposal-apply.js && node --check src/fixture-replay.js && node --check src/node-fixture.js

commands.title: Legacy Code Transformation: Generate Proposal Report
Legacy Code Transformation: Review and Apply Proposal

legacyCodeTransformation.reportDirectory.description: Artifact-only project-relative report directory inside the selected opened root. Hidden, dependency, source directories, and symlink ancestors are rejected.

languageModelTools.name: legacy_code_transformation_demo_generate_proposal_report
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recollect bounded saved source and evidence through owned routines, apply the requested refactor to one selected target, validate the exact proposal, and write a unique Markdown report after extension-owned confirmation. Live mode accepts a bounded changeRequest, defaulting to readability and maintainability while preserving behavior, and requires separate consent showing the exact request and source context. Default mock remains an offline fixed demonstration. Returns the change request, candidate ID, hashes and report path only, never caller patches. Read the report and exact diff and ask the user before invoking ID-only apply. No tests or source writes during generation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Confirm report creation, review the generated report, then separately approve application if wanted.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path exactly matching an opened project workspace folder.

targetFile.description: Absolute saved source file path inside projectRoot.

targetSymbol.description: Exact selected function, method or class name.

mode.description: Use mock unless the user explicitly requests live.

changeRequest.description: Optional desired refactor, passed only in Live mode. Defaults to improving readability and maintainability while preserving behavior.

languageModelTools.name: legacy_code_transformation_demo_apply_proposal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Accept only an extension-owned proposal ID from generation in this session after the user reviews the report and requests application. Mandatory extension modal shows exact file, original, replacement, diff and hashes, independently of tool auto-approval. Applies only known hash-verified pizza or Node replacements after disposable before/after tests and replay. No caller patches or approval flags.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Confirm an exact stored proposal, verify controlled fixture behavior on a disposable copy, then apply only if source and report remain current.

languageModelTools.name: legacy_code_transformation_demo_discover_target
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only discovery for one function or class in the exact open project root. Returns in-root document symbols, references, call hierarchy when available, and bounded text matches. C# analysis requires confirmation because MSBuild design-time targets may run project-defined tasks; declining uses syntax-only Roslyn analysis and bounded text evidence.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Collect source-grounded evidence; C# provider analysis asks before project loading.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project folder. It must exactly match an open VS Code workspace folder.

targetFile.description: Absolute path of the target source file under projectRoot.

targetSymbol.description: Exact function, method, or class name to inspect.

languageModelTools.name: legacy_code_transformation_demo_read_source_evidence
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a requested one-based line range from normalized project-relative paths in the exact open project root. Use only for paths identified by bounded discovery. This tool is read-only and never reads outside the root.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read focused source, test, README, or documentation excerpts inside the selected project root.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the project folder. It must exactly match an open VS Code workspace folder.

path.description: Normalized project-relative path using forward slashes, returned by bounded discovery.

endLine.description: Last one-based line to read, inclusive.
